concerns.text: FR identifier typo – the mapping table lists `FR‑07` instead of the defined `FR‑007` (see spec). This creates a mismatch between the plan and the specification.

The plan does not include any step that validates the processed unified matrix against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` nor validates model output JSON against `contracts/model_output.schema.yaml`. Without explicit contract‑validation tasks, the pipeline may produce artifacts that are not guaranteed to conform to the defined schemas.
